sources.title: Fordham Medieval Sourcebook: Jordanes, Getica
sources.note: English edition of the sixth-century outsider account, including Scandza peoples; used with source-purpose and identification cautions.

sources.title: Ljungkvist and Frolund, Gamla Uppsala: the emergence of a centre and magnate complex
sources.note: Peer-reviewed synthesis of the sixth- to eighth-century estate, mounds, halls, workshops, roads, fences, economy, and eighth- or ninth-century transformation.

sources.title: Uppsala University: Gamla Uppsala research project
sources.note: University project account of the 550 to 650 monumental complex, hall, craft building, hearths, enclosures, roads, farmsteads, and interpretive limits.

sources.title: Uppsala University Gustavianum: Valsgarde burial ground
sources.note: Museum and university account of fifteen unlooted boat graves, excavation history, Vendel-period naming, helmets, glass, and changing interpretation.

sources.title: Uppsala University: Boat grave culture research
sources.note: Research project on prominent people of both sexes, cremations, animal offerings, eastern contacts, and the incomplete publication record.

sources.title: Swedish National Heritage Board: modern analysis of Valsgarde boat graves
sources.note: Heritage laboratory account of imaging and chemical analysis, grave chronology, object conservation, and continuing reassessment.

sources.title: Nichols, Three Dogs from the Late Iron Age Boat Grave Cemetery at Gamla Uppsala
sources.note: Peer-reviewed regional framing of historical Sviars or Svear, Gamla Uppsala, elite burials, animal husbandry, osteological methods, and chronology.

sources.title: Arrhenius, Helgo in the shadow of the dust veil 536-37
sources.note: Peer-reviewed analysis of casting debris, workshop change, permanent settlement, indoor ritual, cemeteries, bread, and the proposed 536 connection.

sources.title: Oxford Research Archive: local supply and long-distance imports at Helgo
sources.note: Peer-reviewed provenance study of lead, copper, brass, ingots, rods, casting waste, and fifth- to early sixth-century supply networks.

sources.title: Warmlander and colleagues, a sixth- to eighth-century silver wire drawplate at Old Uppsala
sources.note: Open peer-reviewed identification and material analysis of a silver-wire tool from the fine-metal workshop beside the hall.

sources.title: Frolund, Settlements and Agriculture in Old Uppsala, 200 BCE to 600 CE
sources.note: University dissertation on settlement, livestock farming, agrarian production, consumption, self-sufficiency, surplus, and central-place development.

sources.title: Stockholm University: archaeobotanical investigations at Vendel and Valsgarde
sources.note: University publication record for plant remains, lipid biomarkers, settlement archaeology, grave food, and interpretation of burial deposits.

sources.title: Styring and colleagues, manuring practices in first-millennium southern Sweden
sources.note: Open peer-reviewed isotope study of four hundred charred cereal grains, including Migration- and Vendel-period samples, and crop-management variability.

sources.title: Schonbeck, Sweden first restoration of an ancient monument at Birka
sources.note: Peer-reviewed site history and chronology, Black Earth settlement, c. 750 foundation, population estimate, graves, excavation history, and preservation.

sources.title: Risberg and colleagues, offshore sediment sequence from Birka
sources.note: Peer-reviewed environmental sequence identifying refuse, latrine cleanings, ditch and storage cleaning, dung, shoreline deposition, and activity phases.

sources.title: Stockholm University: Birka lost moat found by archaeologists
sources.note: University report on geophysical and archaeological work, town boundary interpretation, moat, excavation coverage, and evidentiary limits.

sources.title: Margaryan and colleagues, Population genomics of the Viking world
sources.note: Peer-reviewed ancient-genome study of mobility, ancestry variation, Salme kinship, and the mismatch between genetics and simple cultural labels.

sources.title: Price and colleagues, human remains and place of origin for the Salme boat burials
sources.note: Peer-reviewed isotope and archaeological analysis of the c. 750 dead, probable Malaren-region origins, childhood enamel signals, and geographic uncertainty.

sources.title: Price and colleagues, isotopic provenancing of the Salme ship burials
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of carefully recorded bodies, weapon trauma, seaways, Svear and Gotar framing, and origin inference.

sources.title: Hall, Playing Vikings: childhood enculturation in Viking Age Scandinavia
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of childhood, toys, games, physical activity, martial equipment in some graves, social learning, and interpretive limits.

sources.title: Liebe-Harkort, dental pathology at Alvastra, Sweden
sources.note: Peer-reviewed study of caries in an agricultural Early Iron Age Swedish burial population and the limits of dental health inference.

sources.title: Alfsdotter and Kjellstrom, the Sandby Borg massacre
sources.note: Peer-reviewed osteological and contextual study of twenty-six unburied people killed at an island ringfort around 400 to 550, used as a bounded comparison.

sources.title: Swedish National Heritage Board and Uppsala University: runic inscription U 877, Mojbro
sources.note: Authoritative database record for provenance, date 375/400 to 560/570, Proto-Norse text, English translation, unknown carver, and museum attribution.
